_comment: Provenance for the product screenshots on tools/50-upgrades.html. The images are made by the planner's own repository, from its own test suite, against the payload it ships; this file records which build they are of, so a stale shot can be identified rather than suspected. build29.py renders the source line from these fields and never from a typed sentence.
_regenerate: Ask the planner for a fresh handover/shots/ run, copy the PNGs into _media/, and update every field here from its MANIFEST.md. Then re-verify payload_verified below.

payload_verified.how: fetched the live items-index.json and hashed it here, rather than taking the manifest's word

character: Ashvane, invented for the capture and geared by the planner's own auto-fill against the shipped catalogue. No real character, account or inventory export is loaded by the spec that takes these.

held._why: CLAUDE.md section 7 reserves the site's own character names to credits.html, once. Two of the seven shots offered render the owner's character name and are held until the planner stops printing it: the landing page's demo card, and the sources page's citation of tier0-inventory-<character>.txt. Measured 3 Sep 2026 by grepping the planner's shipped bundle, which carries the name three times - demo card, form placeholder, source citation. The placeholder is fine: section 7 exempts sample inputs on tools. The other two are not.
